app_name: SAP WM Transfer Order Data Processor
description: A specialized landing app for uploading warehouse logistics data, automatically generating computed columns (extracting 2 chars from 4th char of Source Storage Bin), and organizing Transfer Order data into interactive range cards with SAP copy-paste optimization.

headings.classes: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900

layouts.dashboard_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6 p-6
layouts.hero_section: flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-12 px-4 text-center

key_features: File Upload (CSV/Excel/Paste raw tabular data with Source Storage Bin & Transfer Order Number)
Automatic Data Processing & Dynamic Row Generation (Extracts 2 chars from 4th char of Source Storage Bin)
Transfer Order Card Grid with Custom Range Selector (e.g. Batches of 5: Row 1-5, Row 5-10, etc.)
SAP Grid Copy-Paste Optimized Table Viewer with TSV / Tab-separated copy support for direct pasting into SAP GUI/Fiori
Interactive filtering & Search across Transfer Orders and Storage Bins
Sample Dataset Loader for instant demo testing

image_urls.description: Warehouse inventory racks and boxes for logistic background

accessibility.contrast_ratio: WCAG AA compliant (minimum 4.5:1 for body text)
accessibility.aria_attributes: Included on all interactive buttons, modal dialogs, cards, and file upload dropzones.
